name: Main build status
author: Brett
description: A dot on the banner, next to the clock, with the last CI result of the main branch of MossesX/AmberX-AXF (workflow “Android framework + console”): green “main ✓ 2m ago”, red “main ✗”, accent while it runs, grey when unknown. Tap it for the run title, commit, time and failed jobs, with a link to the run on GitHub. Repository, branch and workflow are settings (more than one may be watched). Built from the framework's status widget; the console server reads GitHub with its own token, which never reaches the browser.
